name: vt-applied-ground

graded_by.test: owed by the E2 core plan
owed by the E2 vt plan

description: The ground marks (D22; C4 decision 8). applied is batched and lists, in mid_sequence, exactly the output seqs after which the parser was not at ground; through_seq is the highest seq applied when the mark is sent. It is what a page needs to start at a parser-clean boundary (5.48), so the mark is published e2 and required green only from e5 — pages are the only consumer. After hello, the grid's open and the frames, the VT sends one applied naming the mid-sequence frames and one naming none. Graded by the U4 worker (owed) and the U2 core (owed).
